### How Turbonomic Helps Unilever Leverage AI‑Driven Multi‑Cloud Observability | **Goal** | **Turbonomic’s Approach** | **Why It Matters for Unilever** | |----------|---------------------------|--------------------------------| | **Unified Visibility Across All Clouds** | • One pane of glass that pulls telemetry from AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Kubernetes clusters, on‑prem VMs, SaaS apps, and even edge devices.
• Normalizes metrics into a single data model so you don’t have to juggle dozens of dashboards. | *Unilever* runs workloads spanning public clouds, private datacenters, and hybrid environments—having one source of truth eliminates blind spots and reduces toil. | | **Real‑Time Resource Optimization & Auto‑Scaling** | • Uses machine learning models built on historical usage patterns + business SLAs to predict when resources will become under‑utilized or over‑provisioned.
• Automatically moves workloads, rightsizes instances, or adjusts autoscaling policies before performance degrades. | Keeps production systems responsive while cutting wasteful spend—a key KPI for sustainability initiatives at Unilever. | | **Predictive Capacity Planning** | • Forecasts future demand spikes based on seasonality, marketing campaigns, supply‑chain events, and external factors (e.g., weather forecasts affecting retail traffic).
• Generates “what‑if” scenarios to evaluate cost versus risk trade‑offs. | Enables proactive budgeting and ensures critical consumer‑facing applications stay available during peak periods. | | **Policy‑Based Governance** | • Define high‑level business rules (“no more than X% idle CPU”, “critical app must run on dedicated hardware”) once and let Turbonomic enforce them automatically across all providers. | Reduces manual compliance work and guarantees consistent policy enforcement regardless of where the workload lives. | | **Cross‑Provider Cost Attribution** | • Breaks down costs per application, team, product line, or region using AI‑derived attribution algorithms.
• Provides actionable insights into which workloads drive bill growth. | Supports Unilever’s finance teams in aligning IT spending with brand strategy and regional budgets. | #### Key Features That Give Turbonomic an Edge Over Native Cloud Monitoring 1. **Multi‑Vendor Data Fusion** - Native tools (Amazon CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Google Operations) each expose provider‑specific APIs and metric schemas. - Turbonomic ingests those feeds, normalizes them, and correlates them against its own internal state engine—all within seconds. 2. **Intelligent Decision Engine** - Built‑in ML models continuously learn from your environment’s behavior. - Native monitoring only alerts you when thresholds are breached—it does not recommend actions or auto‑apply changes without human intervention. 3. **Automated Remediation Loop** - Turbonomic can trigger API calls to resize instances, move containers, adjust quotas, or spin up new nodes autonomously. - Native tooling requires separate scripts or third‑party automation orchestrators (Terraform, Pulumi, etc.) to act upon alerts. 4. **Cost‑Optimizing Recommendations** - Predictive pricing models consider spot/preemptible instance availability, reserved‑instance contracts, savings plans, and vendor discounts simultaneously. - Native platforms offer basic cost explorer dashboards but lack integrated recommendation engines that span multiple clouds. 5. **Compliance & Policy Enforcement** - Turbonomic enforces enterprise policies consistently across heterogeneous infrastructures. - Each cloud platform has its own governance mechanisms (IAM roles, tags, resource groups); reconciling them manually is error‑prone. --- ### Practical Use Cases for Unilever | Scenario | What Turbonomic Does | Expected Benefit | |---------|----------------------|------------------| | **Seasonal Retail Traffic Surge** | Detects increased container load in e‑commerce microservices → recommends scaling out to higher‑capacity zones pre‑emptively. | Avoids checkout failures during Black Friday sales. | | **Supply Chain Analytics Platform** | Consolidates GPU utilization across AWS SageMaker, Azure Machine Learning, and GCP Vertex AI → suggests right‑size cluster sizes. | Cuts compute spend by ~15 % while maintaining training throughput. | | **Global Marketing Campaign Launch** | Monitors CDN cache hit ratios globally → triggers replication of static assets to nearest regions. | Improves page load times for consumers worldwide. | | **Regulatory Compliance Audits** | Enforces encryption-at-rest policies across all storage buckets irrespective of provider. | Simplifies audit reports and mitigates breach risks. | --- ### Why Turbonomic Is Complementary – Not Replacing – Native Tools | Feature | Turbonomic | Native Cloud Tool | |--------|------------|-------------------| | **Metric Collection** | Pulls from CloudWatch / Azure Monitor / OpsSuite via SDK/APIs | Exposes raw logs/metrics specific to its ecosystem | | **Data Model** | Unified schema (CPU %, memory %, latency, cost, SLA) | Provider‑centric schema | | **Analytics Layer** | Real‑time AI inference + batch forecasting | Basic alerting, dashboards | | **Automation** | Executes remediation through provider APIs | Requires custom Lambda/Powershell/Gcloud commands | | **Governance** | Enterprise‑wide policy engine | Role‑based access control per service | | **Reporting** | Cross‑provider cost breakdown, ROI calculators | Vendor‑only billing views | In short, Turbonomic sits **above** the native monitoring stack, acting as an orchestration layer that consumes the rich telemetry produced by each cloud provider and turns it into intelligent, automated decisions that keep Unilever’s global digital footprint efficient, compliant, and resilient. --- ### Next Steps for Unilever 1. **Discovery Workshop** – Map current workloads, identify pain points (cost drift, SLA violations). 2. **Proof‑of‑Concept Deployment** – Connect Turbonomic to a subset of AWS/EKS, Azure AKS, and GKE clusters. 3. **Pilot Automation Policies** – Start with non‑critical workloads to validate recommendations. 4. **Scale Out** – Expand coverage to include on‑prem VMware vSphere, SAP HANA, and legacy ERP systems. 5. **Continuous Improvement** – Feed back operational outcomes into Turbonomic’s ML models for better accuracy over time. By integrating Turbonomic into its existing observability pipeline, Unilever can unlock end‑to‑end visibility, reduce operating expenses, accelerate innovation cycles, and maintain regulatory compliance across its sprawling multi‑cloud landscape.
